transcript.text: I need to flag a regulatory-capital constraint that hasn't been reflected in our dashboard yet. I received a memo this week stating that $4,000,000 of the central liquidity reserve is treated as a ring-fenced liquidity buffer. That portion may only be released after exactly $4,000,000 of eligible government securities is transferred into the reserve. The memo has not yet been added to the capital-policy register, which is likely why the treasury dashboard still labels the full $16,000,000 as available. In practice, this means only $12,000,000 of the reserve is freely releasable unless and until we complete that securities transfer.
